is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (specifically An. gambiae and An. coluzzii) across Côte d'Ivoire (page 1, Abstract; page 5, 'Species identification and target site resistance mechanisms').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study tests for Vgsc L995F ('Kdr L1014F') and Ace-1 G280S ('Ace-1R G119S') using TaqMan assays (page 5, 'Species identification and target site resistance mechanisms'; page 8, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 8) reports allelic frequencies along with mosquito sample size N for both Kdr L1014F and Ace-1R G119S in An. gambiae and An. coluzzii for both larval catches and adult catches across three ecological zones.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae and adults between July and October 2020 across six sentinel sites in Côte d'Ivoire (Korhogo, Man, Bouaké, Sakassou, Aboisso, and Bassam) (page 3, 'Mosquito sampling').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper describing original entomological sampling, insecticide bioassays, and molecular genotyping conducted by the authors.

sub_country_location.evidence: Six sentinel sites across three ecological zones in Côte d'Ivoire: Korhogo (savannah), Man, Bouake, Sakassou (pre-forest), and Aboisso and Bassam (forest) (page 3, 'Study sites and design', Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were carried out from July to October 2020 (page 3, 'Mosquito sampling').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field collections conducted across NMCP sentinel sites in 2020 supported by a BMGF grant through PAMCA.

supplement.evidence: S1 Table ('Variation in allelic frequencies of Kdr L1014F and Ace-1R G119S mutations within members of An. gambiae s.l. by study area') contains the site-specific breakdown of the marker frequencies.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated species composition, insecticide susceptibility (WHO tube tests with deltamethrin, permethrin, and pirimiphos-methyl, with synergist and intensity testing), and allelic frequencies of Vgsc L1014F and Ace-1 G119S in Anopheles gambiae and An. coluzzii collected as larvae and adults from six sentinel sites across three ecological zones in Côte d'Ivoire in 2020.
